email_subject: Application - Marketing Associate, Clinical Education (Peripheral Vascular, EMEA)
email_body:
Dear Stryker Hiring Team,

I would like to apply for the Marketing Associate for Clinical Education role in your Peripheral Vascular division (EMEA).

Two things in the posting stood out to me: turning clinical evidence into content people can actually use, and the field-facing, event-heavy rhythm of the work. My background is digital marketing and web. I write and manage content, build and publish pages in WordPress, and measure what works with Google Analytics and Search Console. Before that I worked as a front-end developer on a healthcare web application in Belgium, so clinical material and medical terminology are not unfamiliar ground. I have lived and worked across Türkiye and Belgium, which makes working with stakeholders from different markets feel natural rather than daunting.

I am fluent in English, based in Zwijndrecht, and available for travel up to 60%.

I would welcome the chance to talk about how I could support your education programmes and congress activities.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Stryker Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Marketing Associate for Clinical Education position in the Peripheral Vascular division.

What draws me to this role is the bridge it builds: clinical evidence on one side, the people who need to understand and apply it on the other. Most of my work sits on that same bridge in a digital form — taking dense material and turning it into content a specific audience can act on. I would like to do that with clinical evidence, disease states and therapy data, for sales teams and healthcare professionals.

At Episto I handle on-page SEO and content for client websites, publishing and maintaining pages in WordPress and tracking what performs with Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Analytics. For a pharmacists' association I am building and maintaining a site that runs a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profiles — detail-heavy, structured work that requires ongoing coordination with the people behind the organisation. Freelance, I run my own sites end to end, from structure and content through to technical audits. I am used to owning a piece of work from brief to delivery, which matters when several deliverables and deadlines run at the same time.

Earlier, in Belgium, I worked as a front-end developer on a healthcare web application. That gave me a feel for the precision clinical material demands and for building tools that people rely on in a professional setting.

I am collaborative by default — my current projects all run through client and team communication — and I am comfortable adapting to new systems and processes. I am fluent in English, native in Turkish, and improving my Dutch. I am based in Zwijndrecht and can travel as the role requires.

I would be glad to discuss how my content, web and analytical skills could support your educational programmes, customer engagement initiatives and congress activities.

Kind regards,

cv_highlights:
Healthcare context: front-end developer on a healthcare web application (ViviDoctor, Belgium, 2018-2019) - comfortable with clinical material and the precision it requires.
Content and CMS: writes and publishes SEO content, and manages websites in WordPress/Elementor/Rank Math - the page-level work behind educational and marketing materials.
Stakeholder collaboration: builds and maintains client sites across consultancy, e-commerce and a pharmacists' association (~600 member profile pages), working within client teams and their requirements.
Analytics and measurement: tracks performance with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs; GA4, Google Ads Search and HubSpot Content Marketing certified - useful for evaluating programme effectiveness.
Fast learner with mobility: daily use of AI tools, Python automation and structured data; fluent English, native Turkish, Dutch in progress; based in Zwijndrecht, available for field travel.
